newsitem.title: USA: U.S. permanently bars oxygen generators as cargo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. permanently bars oxygen generators as cargo.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Transportation announced Monday a permanent extension to a temporary ban on the transportation of chemical oxygen generators as cargo on passenger planes.
The ban was first imposed last May following the crash that month of a Valujet plane in the Florida Everglades, killing 110 people.

The cause of the crash has not yet been formally ruled on by the National Transportation Safety Board but investigators think that oxygen generators put in the plane's hold by a subcontractor may have ignited, triggering a fire.
The ban limits air transportation of chemical oxygen generators to compartments in cargo-only aircraft to which crew has access during flight, a Department statement said.
It applies to domestic passenger-carrying aircraft and passenger-carrying flights of foreign carriers operating to, from or in the United States.
